title: Tableau Public Authoring Specification v0.1
description: Declarative description of a Tableau workbook to generate. Unknown properties are rejected everywhere. Generated from tableau_public_authoring.models.spec.spec_json_schema(); edit that function, never this file. Structural validation only - the server additionally checks cross-references, field existence and encoding compatibility, so a valid document here can still be rejected.

size.description: Needs a measure or an aggregation; a bare dimension has no magnitude to scale a mark by.

detail.description: Tableau's Detail shelf. Each dimension listed here becomes a grouping key, raising the mark count (e.g. one mark per site instead of one per Color value). A field may appear at most once.

tooltips.description: Fields shown on hover. A dimension here is promoted to the Attribute aggregation automatically, because derivation 'None' renders the pill red and the sheet blank.

filters.description: Field names to expose as interactive filter cards. Only CATEGORICAL (value-picker) filters are generated, so each name must be a dimension; a measure is rejected because a value picker over a continuous number is not a usable card. Range filters are not generated.

fit.description: How the viz fills the canvas. Omitted or null uses Tableau's 'Standard' fit, which draws a small viz tucked into the top-left corner.

latitude.description: Map only. The latitude column, placed on Rows. Inferred from a column named Latitude/Lat when omitted. Always averaged: summing coordinates collapses every mark onto one point.

longitude.description: Map only. The longitude column, placed on Columns. Inferred from a column named Longitude/Long/Lon/Lng when omitted.

dashboards.description: VERIFIED against Tableau Public 2026.2.0: title, worksheet zones and fixed sizing all render. Dashboard extras - filter cards, colour legends, highlighters, parameter controls, images, floating zones, device layouts and actions - are understood but not generated. See docs/fixtures/DASHBOARD_FIXTURE_ANALYSIS.md.

name.description: Unique across dashboards, and distinct from every worksheet name: both are registered in <windows> by name.

title.description: Dashboard title. Emits both the title text and the title card that gives it canvas space.

direction.description: Flow direction of the single layout container holding the worksheets.

sizing_mode.description: 'fixed' declares the pixel canvas below; 'automatic' fits the window and forbids width/height.

width.description: Canvas width in PIXELS. Only valid when sizing_mode is 'fixed'.

height.description: Canvas height in PIXELS. Only valid when sizing_mode is 'fixed'.

worksheets.description: Worksheets to place, in layout order. Each must exist and may appear at most once per dashboard.

identifier.description: Lowercase alphanumeric/underscore, starting with a letter.

displayName.description: A caption shown in Tableau. Letters, digits, spaces and . , - _ ( ) / & ' % : + # only, up to 120 characters. Surrounding whitespace is allowed and trimmed by the server.

filesystemPath.description: An absolute path, or a '~' path the server expands. Traversal segments ('..') and null bytes are rejected, and an input file must exist, be a regular file and be under the CSV size caps.

dashboardZone.description: A worksheet placed on a dashboard, referenced by exact worksheet name -- the compiled zone has no id-based link, so a mismatched name renders an empty box.

show_title.description: false hides that worksheet's own title inside the dashboard.

encodingShelf.description: A single-value encoding shelf. null means the encoding is absent, exactly as omitting the key does.
